lesson.title: 7.5 Clothes for the Weather
lesson.unit_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
lesson.unit_outcome: Name the body, feelings, clothes and the weather, say what you need and like, invite with Do you want to ...? and Let's, and ask for help when you do not understand.
lesson.lesson_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
lesson.goal: Choose and describe useful clothing for cold, rainy and hot weather, then leave prepared.
lesson.grammar_function: Name weather clothes, state an explicit need and locate belongings.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Choose and describe useful clothing for cold, rainy and hot weather, then leave prepared.

storyboard.cold: A clearly introduced cold-day outing. Ana lays out a long winter coat, a knitted sweater and a scarf in that order. Keep each item visually distinct from the earlier jacket; garment naming is literal, while weather choices are supported by the spoken request.
storyboard.hands: Continue the same preparation. Ana indicates her cold fingers and locates her complete pair of gloves beside the scarf. The gloves belong to her and remain with her when she leaves.
storyboard.rain: An explicitly separate rainy-day library trip: Ana finds her umbrella, then waterproof boots for her cold toes and feet. The same belongings are visible at departure and library arrival.
storyboard.hot: A separate hot, sunny day. Luis chooses shorts and his known hat for the park; the closing scene shows him at that park with those belongings.
